CLOUD2E LLC is proud to announce that we have been added to the ESP Directory maintained by MSPs for the Protection of Critical Infrastructure—the MSP Collective.

The directory identifies CMMC Level 2 Assessment Certified External Service Providers, including MSPs and MSSPs. The MSP Collective validates each listing with the C3PAO that assessed the provider.

For organizations evaluating managed IT and cybersecurity partners, this provides a public reference point for verifying a provider's assessment certification status.

Thank you to the MSP Collective for maintaining this resource and confirming Cloud2e's inclusion.

View our listing:
https://www.mspcollective.org/esp-directory

#CMMC #MSPCollective #ESPDirectory
